objective: Improve module-resolution performance on frozen ESM and TypeScript graph shapes derived from bench/module-loader: the timed metric resolves every import edge of each frozen graph through the runtime resolver (Bun.resolveSync driver), aligning the score with the only mutable surface. Only src/resolver/** is mutable; exact module-graph load observations (exports and side effects), exact resolution-path checksums, focused upstream resolver tests, and peak RSS no more than baseline +2% are hard gates.

meta.provenance: Current-head OSS-T01 at oven-sh/bun 5187e27669440a72ab1b082f92b7f1b5ca94cfc1; no reference patch or privileged winning artifact. Owner-approved plan revision 2026-07-18 repinned OSS-T01 from a227ad991b62fc4e9b9ee5e998ad6c2e6508fe88 because upstream WebKit prebuilt/generated-source skew makes a227ad99 non-self-buildable. Six interleaved A-A measurements set qBase=14.034003452816037, sigma=0.20940813525668572, qFail=0, and qReference=qBase+max(5*sigma,0.05*abs(qBase-qFail))=15.081044129099466. Metric-narrowing revision 2026-07-22 (owner-endorsed): the timed phase was realigned from whole-process module-graph loads (resolver share ~1-2%, margins swamped by binary-layout and scheduler noise) to a resolution-heavy driver resolving every frozen import edge, scored as the median of interleaved candidate/reference per-pair time ratios against the sealed pristine image binary. qBase is scale-invariant by yardstick construction (baseline == reference scores qBase for any ratio estimator); sigma and qReference are re-derived from the six post-revision stability aggregates via the original construction qBase+max(5*sigma,0.05*abs(qBase-qFail)).

sourceDetails.derivation: Exact pinned source is image-baked without repository metadata; the candidate artifact exposes only src/resolver plus trusted evaluator identity files.

toolchain.dependencies: image-baked Bun install cache, complete Cargo registry cache, rustup toolchain, native build objects, WebKit/Node prebuilt caches, reflect-metadata 0.2.2 and tsyringe 4.8.0

measurement.platform: linux/arm64 Docker Desktop on Apple M3 Max (provisional; frozen-host recalibration required)
measurement.q: reference-normalized per-graph score after all hard gates pass: each graph runs one untimed settling repetition then 30 warm (6 rounds x warmRepetitions) and 7 cold interleaved candidate/reference pairs; each phase is scored as the median per-pair time ratio (adjacent pair members share host state, so frequency drift, contention spikes, and scheduler mode-occupancy luck divide out) and q is the geometric mean over graphs of qBase/sqrt(warmRatio*coldRatio), so a candidate identical to the trusted baseline scores qBase by construction
hardGates: 80 focused upstream resolver tests pass (plus 2 upstream skips and 1 todo; one uid-sensitive auto-install permission case is excluded from the unprivileged test runner)
exact canonical export SHA-256 for every cold and warm observation
exact canonical side-effect SHA-256 for every cold and warm observation
peak RSS for every graph <= frozen baseline +2%
